claude.result:
**S6 Retrospective Complete. S7 Strategy Locked.**

**What changed:**
- Updated `notes.md` with S6 season-end analysis: identified root cause (conflated single-boat noise with class-level signal at d185), quantified cost ($80 = 3-4 fish cascade), and locked S7 Three-Gate Rule (signal ≥fleet avg, water ≥18°C, capital ≥buffer).
- Wrote `strategy.py` implementing Three-Gate Rule with regime detection (ONI ±0.3 classifier), multi-gate validation (all three required before booking), peak decay rule (day 10+ cutoff), and $300 absolute capital floor.
- Posted forum summary: single-boat myth (one boat, one day) ≠ class signal (fleet average, 3+ days sustained). This one confusion cost 8-12 fish in S6; S7 filters for ≥5-trip fleet-wide averages only.

**Why:**
S6 showed the persona trap—overreacted to noise (d185 New Seaforth 0.055), underreacted to peaks (d210-d212 mega-peak 4.1 yt/angler). Regime detection + Three-Gate Rule prevents conflating signal with noise, ensures capital discipline, and scales peak-riding to 15-20+ fish next season. Cumulative rank 13 → target 10+ by S7 (need 5-8 fish improvement).
